ref.description: Reference amino acid at the substituted position, as a one-letter code.

alt.description: Substituting amino acid, as a one-letter code.

aapos.description: 1-based position of the substituted residue within the protein.

refcodon.description: Reference codon at the substituted position.

gene_name.description: HGNC symbol of the gene encoding the protein.

protein_name.description: UniProtKB entry name of the protein.

protein_id.description: Ensembl protein ID the substitution is described against, with its version suffix removed.

codonpos.description: Which of the three codon positions the underlying nucleotide change falls at.

hgvsc.description: HGVS coding-level description of the nucleotide change that produces this substitution.

hgvsp.description: HGVS protein-level description of the amino acid substitution. Substitutions at the start codon are written p.Met1? so that they match dbNSFP.

transcript_id.description: Ensembl transcript ID the coding change is described against, with its version suffix removed.
